name: Ordnance Inc
summary:
Ordnance Inc is a VR throwing game where you blow up old and faulty explosive devices using a variety of questionable grenades, all within a shoe-string budget.

Containing thirty levels of various difficulties combined with immersive audio the game will give you the experience you need to intern at a variety of extremely unsafe companies.

Ordnance Inc - We Feel Safety Is Something To Be Concerned About!
